title: Contingent Chain-of-Thought effects and causal overclaiming in LLMs
description:
Code, summary data, the five figures and a Lean 4 formalization for a manuscript examining how zero-shot chain-of-thought prompt prefixes shape the hidden-state trajectories of large language models (journal: Patterns, Cell Press).

The record contains the plotting and analysis code, the summary data underlying each figure and table, the manuscript figures in PNG, JPG, TIFF and SVG, per-experiment documentation mapping each claim to its file, and the Lean 4 formalization (lake build passing). The plotting scripts regenerate Figures 2-5 of the manuscript byte for byte from the included data. Raw inference artifacts are attached to the GitHub release of the same repository.

Code is released under the MIT license; data and figures under CC BY 4.0. Third-party benchmark datasets (GSM8K, AIME 2024, MMLU, CMMLU, HumanEval) are not redistributed; only derived summary statistics and prompts are included.
